units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 1:13">Targ. Job I, 13</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 14b:11">B. Bath. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>אַתְחוּלֵי … לא מַתְחִילִינָן</he> with evil we do not begin, i.e. in arranging Biblical books we do not place first a book containing evil prophecies.
<cite ref="Berakhot 21b">Ber. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא א׳ בה</he> he had not begun to say his prayers.
<cite ref="Pesachim 105a:5">Pes. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>אתחולי לא מַתְחֲלִינָן</he> we must not begin a meal, opp. <he>פסק</he>; a. v. fr.
